name: groundwork
description: A safe-by-default, batteries-included Claude Code harness starter pack — guardrails + a wiki-grounded quality loop.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Safe-by-default guardrails for Claude Code — blocks supply-chain / disk-destroying / fork-bomb commands and asks before rm -rf, force-push, DROP/TRUNCATE, kubectl delete, secret/credential access, and cloud-resource deletion. Every rule configurable. Plus a redacted audit log.

plugins.name: memory-loop
plugins.description: A memory lifecycle for Claude Code's native memory — a save gate against hallucinated memories, tiered expiry (short-tier memories archived, never deleted), a periodic learning-review nudge, a habit-distillation frame (HABITS.md), and an optional one-time identity setup where the assistant can pick its own name. Local-only.

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: A wiki-grounded implementation loop — planning fixed to a semantic-layer best-practices wiki, a TDD / PDCA / Reflexion verification loop, and a knowledge-capture loop that harvests verified insights into reviewed wiki PRs.
